author: smcarus
title: Will Brent crude be higher on 9 April 2027 than on 12 March 2027?
summary: Give the probability that the price of Brent crude oil (US EIA daily spot price) on the first day published on or after 9 April 2027 is higher than on the day entries close, 12 March 2027. A term-length Quest: the result comes 4 weeks after entries close, so a class can follow it and discuss what moved the price.
knownLimits: EIA publishes daily spot prices a few days late; the Quest settles when the value for the date is out.
Over 4 weeks, supply decisions, the world economy and the dollar all move oil; nobody knows most of that news in advance.
